Use same-bank total inlet/outlet pressure and temperature, calibrated mass flow and turbo shaft speed to obtain on-engine operating points.

maps.scope: Compressor and turbine maps for Porsche 993 Turbo K16-6735/6736 units, related Porsche applications, and documented alternatives. The user targets more than 550 metric hp at the crankshaft, prioritizes power, and plans to convert the existing K16 units to hybrids.
conclusions: No exact OEM map explicitly identified as the Porsche 993 K16-6735/6736 was confirmed in the sources consulted. This does not establish that such a map does not exist.

SJM publicly hosts a scan of a KKK 2467 GGA/GGB map associated with the Audi upgrade K16 5316 988 6717. The compressor code overlaps the K16-2467GGA/8.88 designation reported by TurboMaster for the 993. The complete turbocharger and exact housing configuration are different or unconfirmed. This is a candidate family comparison, not a validated 993 OEM map.
Turbomap.ch lists compressor and turbine measurements for the Porsche 996 M96/70 K16-2467G. SAE-format numerical data are offered by quotation; no directly downloadable Porsche map was observed.

Garrett publishes compressor maps and turbine flow curves for the GT2860RS and G25-550. These turbine curves do not necessarily provide a complete turbine efficiency map. BorgWarner publishes EFR6258 and EFR6758 compressor maps in its official catalog.
An engine power curve alone does not provide corrected flow, efficiency, or turbocharger shaft speed, and cannot uniquely identify a compressor or turbine map.

A map for an alternative wheel in its manufacturer housing cannot automatically be assigned to the same wheel installed in a machined K16 housing. Diffuser and volute geometry, clearances, and other housing details affect performance.

The highest speed line drawn on a map is not automatically the mechanical rotor speed limit. Garrett explicitly states a 185000 rpm limit for the G25-550. The SJM KKK 160000 rpm line and EFR 168000/154000 rpm lines are only observed plotted speed lines here.
discard_or_qualify: The public Garrett GT2560R page contains inconsistent power ranges: 170-270 hp in its heading and 200-330 hp in its table. Do not reuse these ranges without resolving the discrepancy. The page links compressor and turbine-flow maps, but its power figures were excluded from this comparison.

The BorgWarner catalog capacities of 500 hp for stock K16 units and 555 hp for the 993 upgrade are commercial envelopes, not maps or evidence of sustained operation at the target. The 993 upgrade references are 53249887003+7004 and are distinct from Audi K24 map references.
Do not reproduce downloaded third-party maps or guides in the deliverables. Cite their URLs and summarize factual information.

restomods.scope: Restomod comparison with the Porsche 993 Turbo M64/60 for a target above 550 metric hp at the crankshaft. Official pages consulted on 2026-10-02.
restomods.conclusion: Singer and Gunther Werks specifications describe engine architectures and advertised outputs. None of the four consulted pages publishes a compressor map, turbine map, rotor speed, or sufficient measurements to reconstruct the original K16 maps.
restomods.practical_value: Use these sources to compare cooling, intake, control, and nominal operating ranges. For a K16 hybrid above 550 metric hp, request the map for the exact wheel and machined-housing combination, turbine flow, maximum shaft speed, and test protocol from its manufacturer. Advertised power does not provide these measurements.
